organization: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado (BOE)
license: BOE open data reuse (open; confirm attribution terms)
data_freshness: daily (business days); Seccion I (Empresarios) from 2009, Seccion II from 2001
record_shape:
summary JSON/XML lists per-province act bulletins; each bulletin XML holds company acts as

(company) +

(acts prose)

fields.meaning: Publication date of the BORME issue.
BORME section: A = Empresarios (registered acts); C = anuncios y avisos legales.
fields.limitations: Company acts of interest are in section A.
fields.analysis_notes: Filter to section A for company acts.

fields.meaning: ID of a per-province act bulletin.
fields.analysis_notes: Use to fetch the per-province XML.
Province scope of all acts in that bulletin.

fields.meaning: URL of the per-province act bulletin in XML.
fields.analysis_notes: Fetch this for company-level acts; also url_pdf, url_html.

fields.meaning: [bulletin XML] ID of this province bulletin.

fields.limitations: Company name embedded with a sequence number; uppercase; form suffix embedded.
fields.analysis_notes: Split number vs name; the following p.parrafo holds the acts.

fields.meaning: Free-text registered acts for the company (semi-structured Spanish).
example_values: Nombramientos. Liquidador: GAZQUEZ GONZALVEZ JUAN JOSE. Disolución. Voluntaria. Extinción.  Datos registrales. T 2045 , F 33, S 8, H AL 52199, I/A 4 ( 8.01.24).
fields.code_list: acto types: Constitución, Nombramientos, Ceses/Dimisiones, Reelecciones, Ampliación/Reducción de capital, Declaración de unipersonalidad, Modificaciones estatutarias, Disolución, Extinción, Cambio de domicilio, Auditor
fields.limitations: PROSE — requires NLP/regex parsing (bormeparser). Contains personal data (administrators/sole shareholders/liquidators).
fields.analysis_notes: Parse acto types into structured events; PII -> GDPR.

fields.meaning: Registry sheet identifier (province letters + number), the stable per-company register key.
fields.limitations: Parsed from the 'Datos registrales' tail (T/F/S/H/IA). Province-scoped.
fields.analysis_notes: Use as the dedup/join key for a company master when CIF is absent.

fields.meaning: Tomo (T), Folio (F), Sección (S), Inscripción/Asiento (I/A) of the registry entry.
fields.analysis_notes: Together with H pinpoints the registry record.

fields.meaning: Share capital stated in a Constitución / Ampliación de capital act.
fields.limitations: Spanish number format (1.234,56). Register capital, NOT annual-accounts data.
fields.analysis_notes: Parse with es locale; capture 'Resultante Suscrito' on capital increases.

fields.meaning: Appointed/ceased officers (administrators, sole admin, liquidator, auditor).
fields.code_list: roles: Adm. Unico, Adm. Solidario, Adm. Mancomunado, Consejero, Liquidador, Auditor, Apoderado
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA. Auditor may be a company. Name order is surname-first prose.
fields.analysis_notes: Parse role + name; GDPR for natural persons.

fields.path: parrafo -> Declaración de unipersonalidad -> Socio único
fields.limitations: PERSONAL DATA when a natural person. Only the sole-shareholder case; no general cap table.
fields.analysis_notes: Closest open ownership signal in Spain; full ownership is not in BORME.

fields.limitations: Derive status + date from the act.
